title: Glazing Paperwork Done for You | RAMS, Signed Notes, Branded Quotes | Coglass
description: RAMS started from the survey, signed collection and delivery notes, purchase orders with the drawing, and branded quotes, invoices and emails — produced by Coglass from the job.
lead: Everything you need to send or keep is built from what is already on the job: a risk assessment started from the survey, signed notes when glass is collected or delivered, purchase orders with the drawing on them, and quotes and invoices in your branding.
steps_sub: The survey, the work bench and the sign-off on site feed every document — nobody types it twice.
steps: The access level recorded on the survey starts the equipment list on a new risk assessment, on the desktop and in the phone app.
Branded quote PDFs with the glass drawn on each line; purchase orders to your supplier with the same drawing.
The customer signs on screen; the signed note is stored on the job.
A branded invoice PDF, emailed in your layout, with a link to pay online.
inc_sub: All in your logo and colours, all kept on the job.
included: Scaffold, ladders, MEWP: the access level on the survey fills the equipment list on a new RAMS.
Risk assessment and method statement as a branded PDF, approved before it goes out and kept on the job.
Itemised, signed on screen with the collector's name, and emailed to the customer.
With the customer's signature and a proof photo, ready to download.
Your logo and colour, the glass drawn on each line, and a link to accept online.
Deposit, proforma and final invoices with totals, balance and a pay-online link.
Numbered per job, with the pane drawn on the PO, emailed to the supplier with the PDF attached.
A cutting-sheet PDF for the workshop, grouped by station.
Every customer email uses one layout with your logo — and you can write your own templates.

stories.label: The documents that matter
stories.h2: RAMS and purchase orders, from the job
stories.sub: The two documents that cause the most trouble when they are wrong: the RAMS a main contractor asks for, and the PO a supplier makes the glass from.

items.title: RAMS a main contractor will accept
items.problem: Commercial work needs a risk assessment and method statement before you are allowed on site, and writing one from scratch for every school or office takes an evening.
items.fix: On the job’s Documents tab, Create RAMS reads the survey, the order and the booking and fills in a draft — the access equipment from the survey’s access level, and the hazards and work steps from your own RAMS rules. Save good ones as templates.
see: Draft, ready for approval, approved and issued — with versions, so an approved PDF never changes
A warning if someone on the crew is missing a safety card the job needs, such as a CSCS card
Send to main contractor emails the PDF; fitters see the approved version on their phones

items.title: Purchase orders the supplier can’t misread
items.problem: A supplier makes a unit with the holes in the wrong place because the order said “holes as discussed”.
items.fix: Every purchase order is built from the work bench line, with the pane drawn on it and a number tied to the job (0080-1, 0080-2…).
see: The drawing, sizes and make-up on the PO PDF
The PO number on the job, so delivery notes and supplier invoices match straight back
